question: How many home games did the Lakers play in the 2022-23 regular season?

question: What is the average points scored by the Warriors at home in the 2022-23 regular season?

question: List the top 5 teams by total home wins in the 2022-23 regular season.
sql: SELECT h.full_name, COUNT(*) AS wins FROM game g JOIN team h ON h.team_id = g.home_team_id WHERE g.home_score > g.away_score AND g.season = '2022-23' AND g.season_type = 'Regular Season' GROUP BY h.full_name ORDER BY wins DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Which team had the highest average home points per game in the 2022-23 regular season?
sql: SELECT h.full_name, AVG(g.home_score) AS avg_pts FROM game g JOIN team h ON h.team_id = g.home_team_id WHERE g.season = '2022-23' AND g.season_type = 'Regular Season' GROUP BY h.full_name ORDER BY avg_pts DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which teams had a home win rate above 70% in the 2022-23 regular season?
sql: SELECT h.full_name, AVG(CASE WHEN g.home_score > g.away_score THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) AS win_rate FROM game g JOIN team h ON h.team_id = g.home_team_id WHERE g.season = '2022-23' AND g.season_type = 'Regular Season' GROUP BY h.full_name HAVING AVG(CASE WHEN g.home_score > g.away_score THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) > 0.7 ORDER BY win_rate DESC;

question: How many regular season games did the Celtics win against the Lakers since the 2010-11 season?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_game_log l JOIN team t ON t.team_id = l.team_id JOIN team o ON o.team_id = l.opponent_team_id WHERE t.full_name = 'Boston Celtics' AND o.full_name = 'Los Angeles Lakers' AND l.wl = 'W' AND l.season_type = 'Regular Season' AND l.season >= '2010-11';

question: Which team had the highest average 3-point percentage at home across all playoff games since 1996-97?
sql: SELECT t.full_name, AVG(l.fg3_pct) AS avg_3p FROM team_game_log l JOIN team t ON t.team_id = l.team_id WHERE l.is_home AND l.season_type = 'Playoffs' AND l.fg3_pct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.full_name ORDER BY avg_3p DESC LIMIT 1;

question: List the 10 highest-scoring home team performances since 1996-97.
sql: SELECT g.game_date, h.full_name AS home_team, g.home_score, a.full_name AS away_team, g.away_score FROM game g JOIN team h ON h.team_id = g.home_team_id JOIN team a ON a.team_id = g.away_team_id ORDER BY g.home_score DESC, g.game_date LIMIT 10;

question: Find teams whose average home points in the 2022-23 regular season exceeded their own average home points in the 2021-22 season.
sql: WITH cur AS (SELECT h.full_name, AVG(g.home_score) AS avg_pts FROM game g JOIN team h ON h.team_id = g.home_team_id WHERE g.season = '2022-23' AND g.season_type = 'Regular Season' GROUP BY h.full_name), prev AS (SELECT h.full_name, AVG(g.home_score) AS avg_pts FROM game g JOIN team h ON h.team_id = g.home_team_id WHERE g.season = '2021-22' AND g.season_type = 'Regular Season' GROUP BY h.full_name) SELECT cur.full_name FROM cur JOIN prev USING (full_name) WHERE cur.avg_pts > prev.avg_pts ORDER BY cur.full_name;

question: Which team improved its average home scoring margin the most from the 2021-22 to the 2022-23 regular season?
sql: WITH cur AS (SELECT h.full_name, AVG(g.home_score - g.away_score) AS margin FROM game g JOIN team h ON h.team_id = g.home_team_id WHERE g.season = '2022-23' AND g.season_type = 'Regular Season' GROUP BY h.full_name), prev AS (SELECT h.full_name, AVG(g.home_score - g.away_score) AS margin FROM game g JOIN team h ON h.team_id = g.home_team_id WHERE g.season = '2021-22' AND g.season_type = 'Regular Season' GROUP BY h.full_name) SELECT cur.full_name, cur.margin - prev.margin AS improvement FROM cur JOIN prev USING (full_name) ORDER BY improvement DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What was the league-wide average home points per game for the 2020-21, 2021-22, and 2022-23 regular seasons?

question: Which team allowed the most points per game at home in the 2022-23 regular season?
sql: SELECT h.full_name, AVG(g.away_score) AS avg_allowed FROM game g JOIN team h ON h.team_id = g.home_team_id WHERE g.season = '2022-23' AND g.season_type = 'Regular Season' GROUP BY h.full_name ORDER BY avg_allowed DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which team had the highest field goal percentage at home in the 2022-23 regular season?
sql: SELECT t.full_name, AVG(l.fg_pct) AS avg_fg FROM team_game_log l JOIN team t ON t.team_id = l.team_id WHERE l.is_home AND l.season = '2022-23' AND l.season_type = 'Regular Season' AND l.fg_pct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.full_name ORDER BY avg_fg DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which team had the lowest turnover average at home in the 2022-23 regular season?
sql: SELECT t.full_name, AVG(l.tov) AS avg_tov FROM team_game_log l JOIN team t ON t.team_id = l.team_id WHERE l.is_home AND l.season = '2022-23' AND l.season_type = 'Regular Season' GROUP BY t.full_name ORDER BY avg_tov ASC LIMIT 1;

question: How many games did the Lakers and Warriors play against each other in the 2022-23 regular season?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_game_log l JOIN team t ON t.team_id = l.team_id JOIN team o ON o.team_id = l.opponent_team_id WHERE t.full_name = 'Los Angeles Lakers' AND o.full_name = 'Golden State Warriors' AND l.season = '2022-23' AND l.season_type = 'Regular Season';

question: Which 5 teams had the most home losses in the 2022-23 regular season?
sql: SELECT h.full_name, COUNT(*) AS losses FROM game g JOIN team h ON h.team_id = g.home_team_id WHERE g.season = '2022-23' AND g.season_type = 'Regular Season' AND g.home_score < g.away_score GROUP BY h.full_name ORDER BY losses DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Which teams scored over 130 points at home more than 10 times in the 2022-23 regular season?
sql: SELECT h.full_name, COUNT(*) AS games FROM game g JOIN team h ON h.team_id = g.home_team_id WHERE g.season = '2022-23' AND g.season_type = 'Regular Season' AND g.home_score > 130 GROUP BY h.full_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY games DESC;

question: Which team had the largest decrease in average home scoring from 2021-22 to 2022-23?
sql: WITH cur AS (SELECT h.full_name, AVG(g.home_score) AS avg_pts FROM game g JOIN team h ON h.team_id = g.home_team_id WHERE g.season = '2022-23' AND g.season_type = 'Regular Season' GROUP BY h.full_name), prev AS (SELECT h.full_name, AVG(g.home_score) AS avg_pts FROM game g JOIN team h ON h.team_id = g.home_team_id WHERE g.season = '2021-22' AND g.season_type = 'Regular Season' GROUP BY h.full_name) SELECT cur.full_name, prev.avg_pts - cur.avg_pts AS decrease FROM cur JOIN prev USING (full_name) ORDER BY decrease DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What was the highest single-game point total scored by any team (home or away) in the 2022-23 regular season?
sql: SELECT MAX(l.pts) FROM team_game_log l WHERE l.season = '2022-23' AND l.season_type = 'Regular Season';

question: Which team won the most of its first 10 home games in the 2022-23 regular season?
sql: SELECT full_name, SUM(won) AS wins FROM (SELECT h.full_name, CASE WHEN g.home_score > g.away_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS won, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY h.full_name ORDER BY g.game_date) AS rn FROM game g JOIN team h ON h.team_id = g.home_team_id WHERE g.season = '2022-23' AND g.season_type = 'Regular Season') firsts WHERE rn <= 10 GROUP BY full_name ORDER BY wins DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which team had the best average home point differential in the 2022-23 regular season?
sql: SELECT h.full_name, AVG(g.home_score - g.away_score) AS net FROM game g JOIN team h ON h.team_id = g.home_team_id WHERE g.season = '2022-23' AND g.season_type = 'Regular Season' GROUP BY h.full_name ORDER BY net DESC LIMIT 1;
